high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "mallikastomar." The post features a photograph of a person standing on a beach, facing the ocean. The individual has long, dark hair and is wearing a black bikini. They are standing in shallow water, with waves gently lapping at their feet. The background shows a clear sky and a distant shoreline with some greenery. The post has received 17,490 likes and includes the caption: "white lies and black beaches miles in between us." The mood of the image is serene and reflective, capturing a moment of solitude and tranquility.
